purpose: Progressive-disclosure manifest for one governed Freedom 250 research package.
title: China Country Orientation — 2026
question: How does China's party-state, economy, military, global strategy and issue-by-issue U.S. relationship fit together?
bluf: There is no single U.S.–China relationship. It is an instrument stack and operating system spanning political direction, diplomacy, trade, industrial dependencies, technology permissions, money, Taiwan and military risk, global institutions and people-to-people ties. China’s strongest industrial leverage often sits in concentrated midstream processing, components and production scale, while U.S. and allied leverage is strongest in frontier technology permissions, aerospace systems and market access. Each lane has different actors, legal objects and substitution clocks. The orientation maps those lanes, preserves publisher perspective and routes detailed claims to the closest issue package.
evidence_cutoff_note: Country-level structure and current orientation were checked against official Chinese institutional and statistical sources, U.S. bilateral trade and policy sources, IMF surveillance and the September 2026 state-visit package. Wave 1 reconciled the relationship instrument stack; wave 2 classified the bilateral operating machine; wave 3 mapped stage-specific reciprocal dependencies and replacement clocks; wave 4 separated the PRC, U.S. and Taiwan legal/policy columns and observable escalation states. Wave 5 joined property, local debt, household demand, prices, demography and industrial support through named balance-sheet owners to external trade and policy results while preserving official-data, IMF-assessment, Chinese-response and observed-outcome boundaries. Wave 6 separated physical exports, cloud training, model weights, inference, talent, capital, data and public AI services into object-specific U.S. and Chinese permission chains, with authorization and operating receipts kept distinct. Wave 7 separated the BRI contract-and-asset umbrella, GDI project machinery, GSI diplomatic/security objects, GCI dialogue institutions and GGI coalition layer, using Chinese initiative texts plus host, UN, FAO, IMF, World Bank and MDB custody. Wave 8 separated visa and transport permission from admission, enrollment, exchange completion, research output, journalist access and subnational operation; it corrected the youth invitation to 50,000 and preserved the Chinese issuer claim of more than 50,000 visits as unreconciled cohort-level evidence. All eight deepening waves are complete at country-orientation level. Product-, event-, household-, firm-, province-, transaction-, project- and participant-level proof gaps remain explicit return gates. Mutable officeholders, rule text, lists, stays, thresholds, license policies, schedules and project/program states must be rechecked at use time.
use_note: Use as the country-level front door before opening a China question. It routes rather than replaces the detailed magnets, e-CNY, IMF, trade, technology, Taiwan and state-visit evidence packages. Keep Chinese official positions, U.S. official positions, multilateral analysis and observed outcomes separate. Registration does not authorize Chronicle promotion, a watch, app/site shipment, commit or push.

availability_semantics.public_reading: The public site contains both the original public view and a crawler-friendly static HTML reading edition. public_full_text is true.
availability_semantics.public_machine_data: The public site contains the complete positively selected structured dataset. public_full_text is true; reading_url and data_url identify the canonical JSON object.
availability_semantics.private_library_metadata: The governed private Research Library contains the material, but the public site exposes only safe title, role and state metadata. public_full_text is false and access_state is private_by_design. Do not infer its contents.

retrieval_instructions: Open full_text_url for the package before treating a summary as the underlying research.
For a public reading, prefer reading_url. For public_machine_data, open data_url and preserve its schema_version, data_as_of, scope_boundary and evidence vocabulary.
A failure to retrieve public_full_text is an access or crawler problem, not a private-by-design signal.
For access_state private_by_design, use metadata only and do not infer contents.
Preserve the package evidence cutoff, evidence_cutoff_note and any material-specific as_of date. Verify time-sensitive claims with fresh primary sources.
Keep fact, project inference, strongest rival, unresolved object and falsifier separate.
